preview: Switched the ultrawide to Hyprland's dwindle layout instead of master. Master pinned the editor to a 2560px half and wasted the outer third; dwindle splits three ways cleanly.
Wrong earlier: the migration was not slow because of the index. CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY held an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock for 40s on a live table. Always CONCURRENTLY.
Quickshell reloads a plugin's QML on file change but keeps the old FileView watchers alive until the shell restarts. Editing a watched path mid-session fires handlers twice.
Prefers stacked branches over one wide PR: one branch per layer (schema, service, UI), each reviewed on its own criteria. Never squash the stack before review.
Standup: the recall panel ships before the briefing tab. Demo mode is the contest gate, so it has to work on a machine with nothing installed.
Settling on Tokyo Night over Catppuccin Mocha for the daily driver. Mocha's low-contrast comments disappear on the OLED at night; Tokyo Night keeps them legible at 40% brightness.
The NVMe special vdev is what made the backup pool usable: metadata-heavy rsync went from 4 hours to 22 minutes. Pool is otherwise spinning rust in a mirror of mirrors.
Wants property-based tests for anything that parses. Hypothesis over hand-written cases for the config loader; example tests only for the specific bugs already hit.
Not a DNS problem. The container could not reach the daemon because host networking was off and 127.0.0.1 resolved inside the namespace. Used host.docker.internal instead.
From the morning walk transcript: agreed with Sam to freeze the plugin API before the contest deadline, and to treat anything after that as v2.
Reads go over the local HTTP daemon, not per-call CLI spawns. A node process per keystroke costs about a second of cold start, and browse only exists on the daemon anyway.
Hyprland's decoration:rounding is the single source of truth for corner radius across the rice. The shell reads it with hyprctl at startup instead of hardcoding a radius.
Keeps LSP diagnostics on the statusline, never as virtual text. Inline diagnostics push code around while typing and make the diff hard to read.
pgbouncer in transaction mode breaks prepared statements for the ORM. Either session mode or disable statement caching; picked session mode since the pool is small.
Restic to the NAS nightly and to B2 weekly, not both nightly. Weekly offsite is enough for a lab, and the B2 egress cost of a full restore test is the real constraint.
Earlier claim was wrong: satisfies does not narrow the inferred type, it only checks it. Needed an explicit annotation to get the union narrowed at the call site.
Screen share needs xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland running, and the Chromium flag for the PipeWire capturer. Without the portal the picker opens and lists nothing.
Wants design docs to pin decisions, not survey options. If a doc says 'candidate approaches' it is not done; each open question needs a chosen answer and the reason.
Nerd Font glyphs render in QML only when the family resolves through the monospace fontconfig alias. Naming the concrete family breaks on font switch.
Dropped the matrix build to a single Linux runner. macOS and Windows jobs caught nothing in six months and ate most of the CI minutes.
The guitar lesson moved to Thursdays at 4pm through the end of the term. Conflicts with the standing infra window, so that moves to Friday.
The alias was not shadowed by a function. It was defined in .zshrc after the plugin manager loaded, and the plugin re-exported the same name later.
uv for everything new, never poetry. Wants the lockfile committed and the venv in .venv at the repo root so the editor finds it without configuration.
The lab runs three VLANs: 10 for trusted, 20 for IoT, 30 for guests. The NAS lives on 10 and is reachable from 20 only on the media ports.
One namespace per project, plus a generalist namespace for anything that spans them. Cross-project recall was returning too much noise from a single shared store.
